questions.stem: Which phrase names the problem?
questions.listenScript: After lunch by the river, the pupils see bags, bottle caps and wrappers caught between the stones. These man-made plastic items are dirtying the shore instead of being put in bins.

questions.stem: These families need milk. Can this small farm p________ fresh milk?
questions.explanation: Use provide after can and keep with before the thing supplied.
questions.parentExplanation: can后用原形provide；provide families with milk中with不能漏。

translation.stem: 这些家庭需要牛奶。这座小农场能为这些家庭提供新鲜牛奶吗？

questions.stem: We must t________ the young trees and water them often.
questions.explanation: Must is followed by the base phrase take care of.
questions.parentExplanation: must后用原形短语take care of，表示照料小树。

translation.stem: 我们必须照料这些小树，经常给它们浇水。

questions.stem: Plastic bags and bottles left on the beach cause p________.
questions.explanation: Plastic pollution names the harm caused by plastic waste.

translation.stem: 留在海滩上的塑料袋和塑料瓶会造成塑料污染。

translation.stem: 不要砍倒这棵树，它为鸟儿提供栖息处。

translation.stem: 新图书馆有数以百计的儿童读物。

questions.stem: Please hold the picture tightly, or the wind will b________.

questions.explanation: With the pronoun it, use blow it away, not blow away it.

passages.text: Our class makes a model island for an open afternoon at school. A blue line around its base marks sea level, and tiny hills rise above it. We want visitors to understand the model without asking us to explain every part. Mia writes short labels beside the hills and the small harbour. “What's more, we can add a key to explain the colours,” Ben suggests. We put the key near the front and ask another pupil to test it. She finds the harbour at once, so we know our display is easier to read.

parallelText.en: Our class makes a model island for an open afternoon at school.
parallelText.zh: 我们班为学校开放日下午活动制作一个岛屿模型。

parallelText.en: A blue line around its base marks sea level, and tiny hills rise above it.
parallelText.zh: 底部一圈蓝线表示海平面，小山丘高出这条线。

parallelText.en: We want visitors to understand the model without asking us to explain every part.
parallelText.zh: 我们希望访客不用逐处询问，也能看懂模型。

parallelText.en: Mia writes short labels beside the hills and the small harbour.
parallelText.zh: 米娅在山丘和小港口旁写上简短标签。

parallelText.en: “What's more, we can add a key to explain the colours,” Ben suggests.
parallelText.zh: “更重要的是，我们可以加上图例来解释颜色。”本建议。

parallelText.en: We put the key near the front and ask another pupil to test it.
parallelText.zh: 我们把图例放在前方，请另一位学生试着看模型。

parallelText.en: She finds the harbour at once, so we know our display is easier to read.
parallelText.zh: 她立刻找到了港口，因此我们知道展示更容易看懂了。

passages.text: Our class is making a small map of the school garden. In an old photo, the stone path is easy to see. Today it is covered by fallen leaves, so we follow its edge rather than stepping into the flower beds. “As far as we know, the path ends at the old gate,” Mia says. Before drawing the final line, we ask the gardener to check our guess. He shows us a short turn behind a bush that is missing from the photo. We change the map and add the date beside the new line.

parallelText.en: Our class is making a small map of the school garden.
parallelText.zh: 我们班正在绘制学校花园的小地图。

parallelText.en: In an old photo, the stone path is easy to see.
parallelText.zh: 旧照片里，石板路清晰可见。

parallelText.en: Today it is covered by fallen leaves, so we follow its edge rather than stepping into the flower beds.
parallelText.zh: 今天它被落叶覆盖，因此我们沿边缘走，不踩进花坛。

parallelText.en: “As far as we know, the path ends at the old gate,” Mia says.
parallelText.zh: “据我们所知，这条路到旧门那里就结束了。”米娅说。

parallelText.en: Before drawing the final line, we ask the gardener to check our guess.
parallelText.zh: 画最后一段线前，我们请园丁确认我们的猜测。

parallelText.en: He shows us a short turn behind a bush that is missing from the photo.
parallelText.zh: 他指出树丛后有一个短弯，照片上没有显示。

parallelText.en: We change the map and add the date beside the new line.
parallelText.zh: 我们修改地图，在新画的线旁标注日期。
